name: Spirit Wolf
description: A prowling spirit beast; weak but agile. Tests early qi-control.

name: River Spirit
description: A playful but unpredictable spirit of the river; may aid or hinder.

name: Scrap Sparrow
description: Tiny spirit bird that pecks at weak cultivators' concentration.

name: Wandering Sage Apprentice
description: A young disciple honing techniques; fights with a mix of qi and blade.

name: Herbal Golem
description: A guardian formed from medicinal herbs. Drops alchemical reagents.

name: Spore Husk
description: A fungal entity that spreads spores causing temporary debuffs.

name: Frost Serpentling
description: A small serpent that chills your Qi and reduces regeneration.

name: Ember Fawn
description: A small flame spirit whose attacks inflict brief burning.

name: Moss Turtle
description: Slow but sturdy; great for learning patience and endurance in fights.

name: Jade Spirit
description: A fragmented elemental bound to a jade shard. Resists mundane attacks.

name: Ancient Sentry
description: An old sentinel animated by sect relics; formidable and precise.

name: Tribulation Serpent
description: Appears during breakthrough attempts; high damage and special stage effects.

name: Relic Guardian
description: A powerful guardian protecting ancient relics; key for end-act events.

name: Ancient Wisp
description: A faint wisp of ancestral energy that flutters about; grants minor insight when defeated.

name: Ember Hare
description: A quick rabbit-like spirit that leaves embers in its wake.
